ns2:section.sectionText: -Students will learn about the methodological and practical issues of field research methods with special emphasis on mixed methods research. -Students will develop their own research proposal (e.g., Master’s thesis, Ph.D. dissertation, research proposal). This graduate seminar is designed for graduate students interested or involved in field research, in particular in the areas of human factors and ergonomics, health systems engineering, quality management and engineering, and other domains related to healthcare quality and patient safety.
